summary: Westport Fuel Systems Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering of 1,600,000 common shares and pre-funded warrants to purchase 3,254,369 common shares at a combined price of $2.06 per share/pre-funded warrant unit, alongside a concurrent private placement of warrants exercisable at $2.06. The offering is being conducted with Craig-Hallum as placement agent on a reasonable best efforts basis. The company's public float is approximately $35M, limiting primary offerings under General Instruction I.B.5 of Form F-3 to one-third of float. The shares trade on Nasdaq and TSX under WPRT. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation.
